Subject: UxonTech onboarding — PO requirement question

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Procurement here (Maya copied) flagged that our standard process requires a PO for any SaaS spend. We're trying to speed the pilot and were hoping Redwood could accept invoices for the first two months while our internal PO is routed (we have a multi-step approval).

Questions:
- Is there a documented temporary invoice-only onboarding path you can accept?
- What evidence / paperwork does Finance need to process invoices without a PO?
- Any limits on monthly spend under that allowance?

We can provide a signed addendum and W-9 quickly. Appreciate any flexibility while we finalize the PO.

Cheers,
Alex Rivera
Head of Platform Partnerships, UxonTech

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: UxonTech onboarding — PO requirement question

Thanks Alex — welcome aboard. Short answers up front: yes, we have a temporary invoice-only path for pilots; yes, Finance requires a few specific artifacts; and we can support a capped two-month exception while the PO is issued. Below is the stepped proposal and requested evidence to make this operational without breaking internal controls.

Proposal (pilot exception):
- Duration: up to 60 days from first invoice date.
- Cap: $30k total or $15k/month (whichever is lower) unless escalated/approved by Finance.
- Billing cadence: 30-day invoices to be paid Net 30.
- Conditions: signed temporary addendum, current W-9, and a named approver in UxonTech with billing authority.

Evidence required by Finance:
1) Executed temporary invoice addendum (we can provide a template).
2) Completed W-9 (or local equivalent).
3) Contact and role of the internal approver who will sign the PO when it arrives.
4) Confirmation of expected PO number timeline (approx ETA).

I attached the temporary addendum template and the onboarding checklist for Finance. If Uxon can return items #1 and #2 by end of day Thursday we can move to activate the account and start invoicing for trial usage. Marissa — I included you for pricing confirmation and to verify the cap is acceptable. Laura / Sean — can Finance approve the temporary terms below?

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_temp-invoice-addendum.pdf (pdf); Redwood-Onboarding-Checklist.docx (docx)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Alex Rivera <alex@uxontech.com>, procurement@uxontech.com
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 16:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: UxonTech onboarding — PO requirement question

Hi all,

Finance is OK with a time-bound invoice-only path under the conditions Soojin outlined, with two clarifications:

1) We need an internal approval email from the named approver at Uxon confirming they authorize invoices up to the cap and understand PO issuance is pending. That can be a short email saved to the vendor file.
2) For risk control we require the first invoice to include a one-line invoice reference: "TEMP-EXC-UXON-202805" so our systems tag it for manual review and expedited payment.

If both items are provided and the W-9 and addendum are signed, we'll provision the billing feed and allow invoices to route to AP. Payments will follow our standard Net 30 schedule. If spend approaches the cap early, we'll automatically pause billing and flag Soojin / Marissa for escalation.

Marissa, confirm the cap and any promotional credit we discussed during the demo so I can note it in the vendor note.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Ops — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Finance-Temporary-Exception-Guidance.pdf (pdf)]
